async_reset_assert: z=0 while areset=1 and state is reset to A
z retains its previous value while areset=1
If Z retains its previous value while areset=1, the final row remains z=1 instead of being forced to z=0.
global: areset=1 asserts reset (active-high); areset=0 releases reset
areset=0 asserts reset (active-low); areset=1 releases reset
Treat reset as active-low: areset=0 asserts reset and areset=1 releases; in the sequence, the final areset=1,x=1 would release reset and produce z=1 instead of the contract's reset z=0.
